title: Alonzo Coker
clean_html:
Alonzo Coker

Preserved Primary Document • coker-a7.htm

He married Rebecca Carney, daughter of James Carney and Efflinda Reed. Rebecca was born in Kent Co., DE in 1897. They had the following children: Walter Coker , married Myrtle Morgan, daughter of Harry Morgan and Frances Durham Carlton Coker , married Anna Loatman, daughter of Samuel Loatman and Margaret Carney Vicktorine Coker, married Jeremiah Durham, son of Presley Durham and Mildred Mosley Mac Donald Coker (1934-1998) Clarence Coker Alonzo died in Kent Co., DE on 6 May, 1957. Rebecca died in 1978. Both are buried at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold, DE.
